scope: Read-only APK, DEX, native symbol disassembly and retained source inspection; no phone execution or filesystem deletion

rootDerivation.proof: Actual DEX method and literal; getArguments/getStorageRoot consume this method
Actual APK AArch64 disassembly and mapped ELF literal, not a guessed URL-derived root

rootDerivation.derivation: Resolve the exact CatalogService::getRomsRoot export, pass its result through JNI; Java canonicalizes the supplied absolute root
rootDerivation.proof: Native bridge source and actual DEX configure/prepareStorage calls

rootDerivation.derivation: <roms root>/.station-v2/<fixed supported platform>/<item id>/install-*/content/<authorized launch entry>
rootDerivation.commitPolicy: Owned generation plus private receipt/pointer; uncommitted generation cleanup only

retainedNativeConfiguration.nextEvidenceNeeded: Observe an exact recreation event after removal while preserving games and config. Current device cfg evidence was read by the parent audit; no device cfg, serial or personal path is copied here.

limitedCreators.source: Actual classes27.dex install calls and retained PlatformAssets source
Retained Station frontend finite local stats initialization

sandboxAttribution.limitation: Native path derivation is confirmed; a recreated directory was not observed. Do not infer its creator or remove user games/saves/resume state from literal matches or retained class names.

legacySamboxAttribution.creationCondition: Switch system is absent from parsed es_systems.cfg; the patcher adds a system entry and creates the legacy ROM directory
legacySamboxAttribution.existingSwitchCondition: An existing Switch system receives setCommand only in this patcher; this branch does not rewrite its path or directly create that ROM directory
legacySamboxAttribution.safeRepair: Replace the obsolete Switch-config generator and migrate only the exact known legacy path without deleting games, saves, firmware, user-custom paths or transaction/resume state. A runtime recreation event must be distinguished from the proven first-create branch.

getGamelistPath.creationCondition: forWrite=true; only the parent of the fallback gamelist is created

nativeSystemDirectoryCreation.limitation: Direct AArch64 calls and constant-path derivation only; indirect calls and future device events are not proved absent. No claim that the native constructor recreated the reported directory.
